correctness.rationale: Every partition with at most three parts admits an explicit higher lexicographic neighbor obtained by transferring one cell to its largest part. Later neighbors fall into three types U,V,W and all lie in the closed neighborhood of the chosen dominator within the surviving induced graph, establishing a strong collapse for every n, not just acyclicity. Independently built partition transfer adjacency by explicit one-cell moves for n=1..80 and verified the entire ordered domination sequence at each n. At n=8, k=4, independently enumerated all 15 partitions and checked nine successive closed-neighborhood dominations and that the six remaining vertices induce K6 minus a perfect matching; the flag complex is S0*S0*S0=S2 with f-vector (6,12,8). The all-n argument is the lex-neighbor proof, not the n<=80 replay.
